name: openbb_fixedincome_sofr
description:
Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR, percent) history through the OpenBB Platform (obb.fixedincome.rate.sofr), in OpenBB's default date window.
Returns: {tool, data_points (total rows), data: first 100 rows as OpenBB returns them} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): provider (OpenBB 4.6 accepts federal_reserve or fred; schema default federal_reserve, but when omitted the tool sends yfinance, which this command rejects, so set it); federal_reserve needs no key.
Other overnight rates: openbb_fixedincome_effr, openbb_fixedincome_estr, openbb_fixedincome_iorb. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"provider": "federal_reserve"}
